dependencies_and_preservation.historical_workflow_reference_status: Both original successful runs/workflow provenance recovered; no proof of complete current non-secret/external consumers.
dependencies_and_preservation.expiry_risk: Both 2026-09-28 original Actions artifacts expire 2026-10-28. Existing Git JSON summaries do not preserve the full original A identity bytes nor guarantee full branch-only database state.
dependencies_and_preservation.preserve_original_artifacts: Separate authorization: place original artifact ZIP bytes and per-member integrity manifest in durable access-controlled evidence store before expiry; independent read-back with byte SHA-256, expiry/retention and allowed-use contract.
dependencies_and_preservation.preserve_database_state_if_authorized: For each exact branch, independently authorized branch-specific read-only snapshot; enumerate full schema/DDL, roles and privileges metadata, relevant tables, exact keys, source content hashes, relationships, checkpoint/run rows, revision pointers and synthetic fixtures. Canonicalize semantic values with explicit excluded volatile columns and hash each row; do not conflate it with accepted deterministic keys.
dependencies_and_preservation.transfer_plan: Only after separate approved destination and export rights: serialize unique branch-only data and experimental receipts into an independent dedicated versioned evidence store, with source-branch manifest, two independent read-backs and reversible restoration proof. No copy or merge in this task.

separate_second_stage_authorization_requ.read_only_scope: Inspect and hash exact present schema/rows in each branch using independently verified read-only compute endpoints and SELECT-only transactions, without altering historical rows or checkpoint/pointer state.
separate_second_stage_authorization_requ.conditional_state_changes: Only if individually authorized: temporary unarchive of exactly A and B; provision or use independently verified read-only compute/role connectivity; minimal time-bounded activation; restore both branches to archived state afterwards and remove only separately authorized temporary compute resources.
separate_second_stage_authorization_requ.prohibited: No parent/authority branch writes, no data copy/import, no reset/restore, no raw public export, no billable plan change, no deletion.
separate_second_stage_authorization_requ.cost_estimate_note: Both current endpoints are read_write and idle; using an independent read-only compute may incur CU-hours. At 0.25 CU per replica, two replicas active for ten minutes consume about 0.083 CU-hours before autoscaling and overhead, but account-specific remaining allowance and actual charges were not independently verified. Authorize only after cost/plan preflight.
separate_second_stage_authorization_requ.safety_stop: If selective read-only connectivity or reversible archived-state restoration cannot be certified, stop before SQL.

independent_verifier.verified_using: Separate local Python ZIP/member/hash/identity-set checks against the two downloaded original Actions ZIPs, independent of original Git proof producer; separate GitHub/Neon API read-only metadata checks.
